summary: The base assertion was reproduced. Exact candidate 95b40aed1aecde89990ac450567e6c320f3e9eea fixes the three reported flat tilers but only a subset of the accepted tiler domain: zipped_divide still aborts for the nested-tiler boundary ((8, 4), None, 40), although logical_divide accepts it.

tests.what_was_measured: Actual base compiler behavior for the three issue tilers; reproduced the native intTupleZip2By assertion on (32, None, None).
Pinned-LLVM native candidate build and real vector-add GPU smoke; native-build.json records MI350X gfx950 execution.
Rebuilt candidate compiler output for all three exact issue tilers; all produced the expected flat zipped layouts without aborting.
Focused candidate regression suite: 34 passed, 1 skipped, including exhaustive independent enumeration of 256,000 offsets for each reported tiler.
Shorter mixed tilers, all-None multi-mode tiler, unit tiles, and full-extent tile boundaries; sole (None,) was rejected by the pre-native Python constructor.
Nested tiler ((8, 4), None, 40): logical_divide exited 0, while candidate zipped_divide aborted at its new tupleRank >= tileRank assertion.

remaining_limitations: Candidate fixes the three flat examples but not nested tilers containing None; changes are requested.
Reporter MI308X was unavailable; testing used assigned MI350X gfx950.
PyCuTe was not installed, so no live CuTe comparison was run.
A sole (None,) tiler fails in the existing Python make_tile binding before native zipped_divide.
